title: Default the gateway to least privilege behind an explicit write-tool allow-list
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/src/common/config/userConfig.ts:74-103, change the shipped defaults so write-capable tools are off unless explicitly enabled: set readOnly .default(true) (or add an enabledTools allow-list defaulting to empty) so the 11 unconfirmed write tools named in fnd_01M2K7B0MJQMT1S973WHW7K9GA (update-many, insert-many, rename-collection, create-collection, create-index, atlas-upgrade-cluster, atlas-create-free-cluster, atlas-create-project, atlas-streams-build and the atlas-local create/delete deployment tools) no longer register by default, and extend confirmationRequiredTools so any allow-listed write tool that mutates pii or financial data is confirmation-gated. Update deploy/aws/Dockerfile:13 so the shipped deploy configuration sets an explicit enabled-tool allow-list (or MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY) instead of overriding only the atlas-local category. Constraints: keep per-tool Zod argsShape validation; PR to protected main with at least 1 approver; no rollout in this task.
acceptanceCriteria: With no explicit tool configuration, a freshly built gateway exposes only read-only tools over tools/list; none of the 11 unconfirmed write tools from fnd_01M2K7B0MJQMT1S973WHW7K9GA is registered.
deploy/aws/Dockerfile no longer relies on MDB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS=atlas-local alone: it ships an explicit enabled-tool allow-list or read-only default for the qa/prod deployment path.
Every write-capable tool an operator allow-lists is either listed in confirmationRequiredTools or covered by the task 1 forced-confirmation flag before it can execute against pii or financial data.

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-agent-graph for mcp-gateway repo mongodb-mcp-server and inspect the SARIF export: expected result - no result with ruleId AGENT-ASI02-01 (fingerprint 5e8d5ad607ba7b8c4f85364640afdeca826d84ab45d32b497c7dba48e91dfb3d) or AGENT-ASI09-01 (fingerprint f658ce80746ca24360bbbc6ea77d7913bf57efcbcb4882305d7036800cecb0f0) is produced, and the probe reports write tools gated behind explicit allow-lists with a fail-closed confirmation path.

rootCause.description: userConfig.ts ships readOnly .default(false), disabledTools .default([]) and a confirmationRequiredTools list covering only 8 of 19 write-capable tools, so the tool-allowlist control of sdlc/policy.json aiCodingPolicy.promptInjectionControls was not implemented for this gateway.
